findings.location: Statement (f), first sentence and the displayed definition of B_K(A) (lines 95–99)
findings.evidence: Statement (f) quantifies over every compact K subset of Omega and defines B_K(A) using real suprema over K, without a convention for an empty supremum. The published def-compact-space explicitly declares the empty space compact. Thus K = empty is admitted, but B_K(A) is undefined as a real number. The assigned consumer pthm-gr-linearized-field-equations has this supplier in its dependency closure.
